description: This file defines the LayoutEvents class, which contains static methods for handling content layout operations such as creating, updating, copying images and subcontent, cloning layouts, and managing associations within the Apache OFBiz content management framework.

classes.name: LayoutEvents
classes.description: A utility class providing static methods for managing layout-related content operations in OFBiz.

methods.name: createLayoutImage
methods.description: Handles uploading and persisting a new layout image, including processing image data, setting mime types, and updating related content entities.

methods.name: updateLayoutImage
methods.description: Updates an existing layout image with new image data, replacing the stored image and metadata.

methods.name: replaceSubContent
methods.description: Replaces or updates a sub-content association with a specified content ID.

methods.name: cloneLayout
methods.description: Clones a layout (Content entity), including associated data resources and content relations, creating copies with new IDs.

methods.name: createLayoutSubContent
methods.description: Creates new sub-content under a specified parent content, establishing the content association.

methods.name: updateLayoutSubContent
methods.description: Updates sub-content, mainly by persisting changes to the associated content and data resource.

methods.name: copyToClip
methods.description: Copies an entity's primary key attributes into a clipboard (memory cache) for reuse, supporting copy-paste operations.
